items.prompt: What does source permit that combination counting helper rejects?

options.why: Coin values must be positive under both contracts; zero is not a permitted denomination.
Repeated denominations leave the same minimum candidate unchanged; unlike combination counting, this helper permits them.
Negative denominations violate the positive-coin contract and do not justify these indexed transitions.
The supplied signature still requires amount; allowing duplicates does not make the target optional.

items.explanation: Repeating a min candidate does not add choices.
